hour_of_day: DERIVED: hour_of_year % 24  (0-23). Computed inside predict.py; the caller does not supply it.
day_of_year: DERIVED: hour_of_year // 24 (0-364). Computed inside predict.py; the caller does not supply it.
changes_from_v1: added hour_of_day and day_of_year (both derived from hour_of_year, no new information required from the user) and re-tuned max_depth with GroupKFold; v1 was capped at max_depth=11 by its search grid.
PPD: derived from predicted PMV via ISO 7730, not a model
GUI_IMPACT: NONE. predict() keeps the same signature; hour_of_day and day_of_year are derived internally from hour_of_year, so app.py and the user-facing interface need no change.
